prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 主流旗舰手机屏幕与价格参数 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "型号" spans 1 col × 2 row; "屏幕" spans 2 col × 1 row; "价格" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 55px · one-line width 172px
  col 2: header "屏幕 › 尺寸" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 74px
  col 3: header "屏幕 › 技术" · longest unbreakable word 87px · one-line width 545px
  col 4: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 42px · one-line width 81px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 467px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 466px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较主流旗舰手机的屏幕尺寸、显示技术与价格。","reading":"读者先按型号定位，再横向查看同一款手机的屏幕和价格；也会纵向比较尺寸、技术和价格。技术描述较长，通常决定行高，可利用这些行高容纳型号换行。","groups":["屏幕尺寸与屏幕技术同属“屏幕”表头，分别用于快速比较尺寸和阅读具体技术配置。","型号是行标识，价格是独立的比较指标；两者需要便于沿列扫描。"],"keep_intact":["手机型号中的品牌、系列和型号标识应尽量完整，避免在标识内部断行。","屏幕尺寸数值与“英寸”应尽量放在一起。","价格数值及其货币单位应尽量保持完整。","屏幕技术中的 OLED、AMOLED、LTPO、120Hz 等缩写和数值应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["屏幕技术描述可在技术名称、特性和标点之间自然换行。","较长型号可在品牌与系列名称之间换行，并利用技术描述形成的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [120, 95, 149, 102] · table 467×922px · row heights [39, 39, 145, 145, 118, 145, 145, 145] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [145, 95, 145, 81] · table 467×974px · row heights [39, 39, 145, 145, 118, 145, 171, 171] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [120, 95, 170, 81] · table 467×816px · row heights [39, 39, 118, 118, 118, 145, 118, 118] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"尺寸和价格均保持单行，便于纵向比较；型号大多在自然位置换行，屏幕分组也清楚。","problems":"技术描述较窄，多数单元格占五行，中文词组和技术特性被频繁拆开，行高较大。","cause":"技术列为149px，扣除内边距和边框后只有128px可用；型号列120px则让部分型号分成两行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"145px的型号列让iPhone 15 Pro和vivo X100 Pro保持单行，行标识较易辨认；尺寸列也保持单行。","problems":"价格数值与“元起”分成两行，纵向比较不够顺畅；技术描述更拥挤，末两行达到六行，整体偏长。","cause":"型号列占用145px，留给技术列和价格列的宽度分别只有145px和81px；价格列扣除21px后不足以容纳完整价格。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"170px的技术列改善了描述的连续性，多数数据行降至四行；尺寸保持单行，型号的两行排列也基本可辨。","problems":"所有价格都在数值与“元起”之间换行，削弱了价格列的快速比较；部分技术描述仍在词组中间断开。","cause":"为了扩宽技术列，价格列缩至81px，扣除21px后无法容纳完整价格；技术列内容区仍只有149px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"price-tech-balance","widths":[110,95,159,102],"change":"在r1A基础上从型号列移出10px给技术列，保留尺寸和价格单行，测试较窄的型号列能否利用现有行高而改善技术描述。"},{"name":"gentle-rebalance","widths":[115,95,155,101],"change":"温和收窄型号列与价格列，将空间转给技术列；兼顾型号辨识、完整价格和技术描述的阅读节奏。"},{"name":"model-priority","widths":[125,95,144,102],"change":"适度加宽型号列，保持尺寸和价格单行，以检验型号辨识的改善是否值得技术列稍窄带来的额外换行。"}]}
